INGLEWOOD, Calif. – The Rams (2-4) fell the Cardinals 18-16 on Sunday at SoFi Stadium.

Trailing 15-9 with just under three minutes remaining, quarterback Matthew Stafford led Los Angeles on a go-ahead scoring drive, with his 6-yard touchdown touchdown pass to tight end Colby Parkinson – and punter Ethan Evans' ensuing successful extra point attempt – to give L.A. a 16-15 lead over Arizona (2-4) with 47 seconds remaining.

Evans was handling placekicks because the Rams lost new kicker Blake Grupe to a knee injury he sustained after tackling Cardinals returner Devin Duvernay on the kickoff attempt following his made 44-yard field goal in the first quarter. Grupe was initially ruled doubtful to return to the game before being downgraded to out early the fourth quarter.
